request.summary: Fix pet-drop Discord alerts to include a screenshot, and narrow total-level achievement alerts to only the 1750/2000/2200 thresholds (dropping all others), also with a screenshot.
request.raw_requirements:
We got a few bugs to fix:

* Pet drops,  we need a screenshot of the drop as well to be posted to the discord
* Total level achievements, we ONLY want to watch for 1750, 2000 and 2200. The others don't matter
   * On that note, we also want a screenshot when these 3 thresholds are met

plan.approach: Both PetDropListener and SkillMilestoneListener already exist and are wired into CatastrophicEventsPlugin under the existing petDropSharingEnabled/accomplishmentSharingEnabled toggles, so this is confined to the alerts/ package: inject ScreenshotCapture into both listeners and route their sendAlert calls through AlertsApiClient's existing (token, kind, summary, title, byte[] pngBytes, callback) overload (already used by AccomplishmentLootListener). For total level, replace the >= MAX_TOTAL_LEVEL (2277) branch with an exact-match check against {1750, 2000, 2200}; all other totals, including 2277/max cape, are now ignored per explicit user decision.
steps: PetDropListener.java: inject ScreenshotCapture; wrap the existing alertsApiClient.sendAlert(...) call in screenshotCapture.capture(png -> ...) using the (token, kind, summary, title=null, pngBytes, callback) overload.

SkillMilestoneListener.java: inject ScreenshotCapture; replace MAX_TOTAL_LEVEL constant with a TRACKED_TOTAL_LEVEL_THRESHOLDS = Set.of(1750, 2000, 2200); in handleTotalLevelMilestone, only proceed if the parsed total is in that set (drop the max-cape branch entirely), then capture a screenshot and send via the same screenshot-carrying sendAlert overload.
Log the max-cape-dropped behavior change via mflow log-decision.

Manual verification: code-read check both listeners compile logically against AlertsApiClient's overloads; real chat-message triggering isn't reproducible outside a live client, so note that in verify-task.

verification.notes: Compile-verified (./gradlew compileJava BUILD SUCCESSFUL), conventions followed, no open blockers or new concerns. Functional UAT (pet-drop screenshot, 1750/2000/2200 screenshot alerts + max-cape/other-threshold suppression, regression of unaffected skill/XP alerts) deferred to post-ship live-client testing per developer - these are real-game-only events not reproducible in this dev environment, consistent with WRN-006's existing precedent for PetDropListener.
